models.name: twitter_organic__tweets
models.description: Each record represents the daily performance of a tweet.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: Date of the report

columns.name: organic_tweet_id
columns.description: The unique ID of the tweet

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the tweet was created

columns.name: tweet_text
columns.description: The full text of the tweet

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: ID of the associated account in Twitter

columns.name: post_url
columns.description: URL of the tweet. Concatenation of 'https://twitter.com/p/status/' and the tweet ID

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: Name of the account in Twitter. Use the most recent name if the account has multiple names

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The ID of the user in Twitter

columns.name: user_name
columns.description: The name of the user

columns.name: app_clicks
columns.description: Number of clicks on app install campaigns

columns.name: card_engagements
columns.description: Number of engagements on cards

columns.name: carousel_swipes
columns.description: Number of swipes on carousels

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: Number of clicks on tweet

columns.name: engagements
columns.description: Number of engagements on tweet

columns.name: follows
columns.description: Number of follows as a result of the tweet

columns.name: impressions
columns.description: Number of impressions on tweet

columns.name: likes
columns.description: Number of likes on tweet

columns.name: poll_card_vote
columns.description: Number of votes on poll cards

columns.name: qualified_impressions
columns.description: Number of qualified impressions on tweet

columns.name: replies
columns.description: Number of replies on tweet

columns.name: retweets
columns.description: Number of retweets on tweet

columns.name: unfollows
columns.description: Number of unfollows as a result of the tweet

columns.name: url_clicks
columns.description: Number of clicks on URLs in tweet

columns.name: video_15_s_views
columns.description: Number of 15-second views on video

columns.name: video_3_s_100_pct_views
columns.description: Total number of views where at least 3 seconds were played while 100% in view.

columns.name: video_6_s_views
columns.description: Number of 6-second views on video

columns.name: video_content_starts
columns.description: Number of times the video content started

columns.name: video_cta_clicks
columns.description: Number of clicks on tweet call-to-actions

columns.name: video_total_views
columns.description: Total number of views on video

columns.name: video_views_100
columns.description: Total number of views where at least 100% of the video was viewed.

columns.name: video_views_25
columns.description: Total number of views where at least 25% of the video was viewed.

columns.name: video_views_50
columns.description: Total number of views where at least 50% of the video was viewed.

columns.name: video_views_75
columns.description: Total number of views where at least 75% of the video was viewed.

config:
Airbyte:
  config:
    files_definition_id: 778daa7c-feaf-4db6-96f3-70fd645acc77
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e
    namespace_definition: destination
    postgres_definition_id: decd338e-5647-4c0b-adf4-da0e75f5a750
    server_url: http://airbyte-abctl-control-plane:80/api/public/v1/
    redshift_definition_id: f7a7d195-377f-cf5b-70a5-be6b819019dc
custom_api:
  config:
    configuration: {}
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - twitter_user_history
flat_files:
- format: csv
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1ZmdgarDCpfG3XWIOwD1lRjGX1nqyuG-p
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: account_history
mongodb:
  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: twitter_organic
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - organic_tweet_report
postgres:
  config:
    database: twitter_organic
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - tweet
    user: postgres
redshift:
  config:
    host: <redshift_hostname>
    port: <redshift_port>
    database: <redshift_db>
    username: <redshift_username>
    password: <redshift_pwd>
    schema: twitter_organic
    s3_bucket_name: <redshift_s3_bucket>
    s3_bucket_region: <redshift_s3_region>
    access_key_id: <redshift_s3_access_key>
    secret_access_key: <redshift_s3_secret_key>
